title: The Key to the Universe
author: Harriette and F. Homer Curtiss
description: The Key to the Universe, or a Spiritual Interpretation of Numbers and Symbols by Harriette Augusta Curtiss and F. Homer Curtiss, founders of the Order of the Christian Mystics (Curtiss Book Company; this copy also carries Samuel Weiser's imprint). First published in 1915, it presents the Curtisses' 'Teachings of the Order of Christian Mystics' on the occult meaning of the numbers 0 to 10, which they regard as keys to the structure of the cosmos and to human spiritual evolution. Each number is discussed through its geometric symbol, astrological and biblical correspondences, Tarot associations, and its lessons for the disciple, with frequent reference to Christ, the cross and initiation. A companion volume, The Key of Destiny, continues with the numbers 11 to 22. It is a characteristic work of early twentieth-century Christian theosophical numerology.
